+     "\n",
+     "# === 排序策略 ===\n",
+     "# 优先级 1: HyDE 成功但 Baseline 失败 (h_rank &lt; 999 and b_rank == 999)\n",
+     "# 优先级 2: HyDE 排名优于 Baseline (h_rank &lt; b_rank)\n",
+     "# 优先级 3: 两者都成功 (h_rank == b_rank)\n",
+     "# 优先级 4: HyDE 失败 (h_rank == 999)\n",
+     "results.sort(key=lambda x: (\n",
+     "    not (x['h_rank'] &lt; 999 and x['b_rank'] == 999),  # 优先展示 HyDE 独家召回\n",
+     "    x['h_rank'] - x['b_rank'],                       # 优先展示 HyDE 排名提升\n",
+     "    x['h_rank']                                      # 优先展示 HyDE 排名靠前\n",
+     "))\n",
+     "\n",
+     "# 选取展示：前2个（正向案例）和后2个（负向或无效案例，如果有）\n",
+     "display_list = results[:2]  # 最好的2个\n",
+     "if len(results) &gt; 4:\n",
+     "    display_list.extend(results[-2:])  # 最差的2个\n",
+     "elif len(results) &gt; 2:\n",
+     "    display_list.extend(results[2:])\n",
+     "\n",
+     "# === 打印结果 ===\n",
+     "print(f\"\\n从 {len(results)} 个测试结果中精选展示：\")\n",
+     "for i, res in enumerate(display_list, 1):\n",
+     "    idx = res['index']\n",
+     "    print(f\"\\n&gt;&gt; 展示案例 {i} (Index: {idx})\")\n",
+     "    print(f\"Query: {res['query'][:50]}...\")\n",
+     "    print(f\"目标页码: {res['target_page']}\")\n",
+     "    print(f\"[HyDE改写结果]: {res['hypo_doc']}\")\n",
+     "    \n",
+     "    b_hit_str = f\"✅ 命中 (#{res['b_rank']})\" if res['b_hit'] else \"❌ 未命中\"\n",
+     "    h_hit_str = f\"✅ 命中 (#{res['h_rank']})\" if res['h_hit'] else \"❌ 未命中\"\n",
+     "    \n",
+     "    print(f\"   Baseline: {b_hit_str:&lt;15} {res['b_pages']}\")\n",
+     "    print(f\"   HyDE:     {h_hit_str:&lt;15} {res['h_pages']}\")\n",
+     "    \n",
+     "    # 简评\n",
+     "    if res['h_hit'] and not res['b_hit']:\n",
+     "        print(\"   ✨ HyDE 成功召回了 Baseline 漏掉的文档！\")\n",
+     "    elif res['h_hit'] and res['b_hit'] and res['h_rank'] &lt; res['b_rank']:\n",
+     "        print(\"   📈 HyDE 提升了排名！\")\n",
+     "    elif not res['h_hit'] and res['b_hit']:\n",
+     "        print(\"   ⚠️ HyDE 丢失了目标文档（负向案例）\")\n",
+     "\n",
+     "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 60)"
+ ]
+ 
+ updated = False
+ for i, cell in enumerate(nb['cells']):
+     source = "".join(cell['source'])
+     if "【HyDE 多用例测试与对比】" in source:
+         print(f"Found target cell at index {i}. Updating display logic.")
+         cell['source'] = new_source
+         updated = True
+         break
+ 
+ if updated:
+     with open(target_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+         json.dump(nb, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
+     print("Notebook updated successfully.")
+ else:
+     print("Target cell not found.")
+
